items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...that's Guieu (phon Guieu) Taylor, you may have heard of Guieu Taylor. He was a good violin player who worked with Basie at the Avalon Theatre.

ctx.x: what I did. you They had a storeroom that was about a hundred by a hundred in diameter. And the ceiling and all the walls were just lined with musical instruments, where Western had had great bands in the past. And all these instruments were here, and the guy said, 'Well, if you want an instrument, get it.' So I took a bass. I came back, and asked him could I have a saxophone. So I was learning saxophone and studying that bass at the same time, myself.
They'd had a real big band there?
They had had, at one time.
